findings.highlight: Assassin’s Master, who seems to be at the Ryuudou Temple
findings.evidenceJa: 柳洞寺に潜むというアサシンのマスター
findings.governingReading: the Master of Assassin, the Servant said to be lurking at Ryuudou Temple
findings.explanation: The temple-lurking modifier is attached to Assassin’s unseen Master instead of Assassin.

findings.highlight: Berserker’s Master, the girl in front of me right now!
findings.evidenceJa: 目の前の少女だけなんだけど！？
findings.governingReading: the only remaining one is the girl directly before him, Berserker’s Master
findings.explanation: The “only one” completion of the three-Master count disappears, weakening the comic collision between exposition and Illya’s arrival.

findings.highlight: You were walking with a difficult expression.
findings.evidenceJa: 難しい顔して歩いてる
findings.governingReading: he was walking with a troubled or serious expression
findings.explanation: A literal transfer produces unnatural English and obscures Illya’s awareness that he is preoccupied.
